name: Rocketlane
description: AI-powered access to Rocketlane for delivery, onboarding, and collaboration. Connect to your Rocketlane workspace to track projects, tasks, and teams, bringing the full context of your work right into Claude. Create tasks, search team members and pull up project summaries without leaving your chat.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Rocketlane to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Rocketlane to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.rocketlane.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Rocketlane MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Rocketlane provides these MCP tools: get_my_profile, get_projects, get_tasks, get_fields, get_users, create_tasks, and get_phases.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Rocketlane?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Rocketlane in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Rocketlane requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Rocketlane is developed by Rocketlane Corp. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
